summary: The Phase 0.1 MCP acceptance harness is correctly implemented: standalone black-box HTTP client targeting a configurable production URL, reuses the slice1-lab case-10 initialize fixture shape, sends a deterministic initialize probe, and intentionally exits 1 against the current non-standards-compatible production component. The self-test (verify.js) passes on both the FAIL and PASS paths. All five acceptance criteria are met.
follow_up: The working tree also contains uncommitted changes from other tasks (backend/src/caldav/*, backend/src/mcp_internal.rs) that are out of scope for this harness task; they belong to the apple-caldav-* and mcp-secure-internal-api tasks.
important_context: The harness default URL is the real production endpoint https://mcal.hajnal.space/mcp; running `node mcp-acceptance/harness.js` with no args makes a live call to production and exits 1 (the intentional Phase 0.1 baseline). CI must set MCP_URL to a production-equivalent deployment and expect a red baseline during Phase 0.
